docs.text: I've been windsurfing since I was 13 yrs old. Windsurfed on all kinds of lakes, the Outter Banks of NC, the Columbia River Gorge off both WA & OR sides, and Maui.. Lake Michigan is the most unpredictable place I've sailed.. It is a very dangerous lake if you are ill prepared.
We be getting that storm now north of you 🙏 Used to it tho, Lake Superior is a harsh mistress
Lovely. Amazing how calm Lake Superior can be and then the power when storms roll in.
That wind off Lake Michigan is a killer, too! Thanks for reading and sharing, Dawn!
Oooo, November rainstorm on its way to the north shore Lake Superior
The winds can be really strong coming off of Lake Superior

There are some things you learn best in calm, and some in storm. - Willa Cather You can feel the Fury of the North today pounding 🌊❄️ The Portage River Lighthouse stands tall as Lake Superior unleashes its winter wrath. Nature’s power, raw and relentless.
the rain seems to have stopped and i haven’t heard any crazy winds. maybe lake superior did a good job of getting rid of it
The wind is right off Lake Superior so it’s very loud and strong today
Or more evocatively, soft as a storm on Lake Superior.
Yeah, the Lake Huron/Erie lake effect storms are brutal. I've always been curious about life in the North and really appreciate what you share, Peter. Brilliant stuff! 👍🏻

I've been riding my TT bike on the north shore of Lake Superior. I'll go across a gap in the trees and the wind gusts will push the disc wheel sideways like a sail. Yesterday I thought I was going down for sure, but managed to keep it upright.
